findings.conclusion: Shared per-role/group cursor scans all 750 candidate addresses under its monitor; 256 platform route planners create a serialized contention point. This hotspot is unchanged in baseline and candidate. Individual waits overlap the tail burst; new submission/drain locks are not a leading profile hotspot.
Different failure mode from 121ms run. Lowering virtual thread scheduler parallelism to 32 is a diagnostic control, not a production change or a proof of all-SLO stability.

Protobuf input parsing, queue projection/planning, per-request Decode snapshot/list/arrays and Prefill discovery dominate sampled allocations in both versions. Allocation sample weights are statistical estimates, not exact byte counts; idle condition parks and epoll native samples are not CPU hotspots.

findings.kind: functional race present in both versions
findings.exception: IllegalStateException: terminal record retains request-owned state
findings.mechanism: inactivityDeadlineAtMs permits FINALIZING while delivery exists. Finalization detaches/cancels old timers; finishAdmission can install a new inactivity timer before delivery settlement commits the terminal. finishTerminal then throws its invariant after setting FINISHED, so archive is skipped. Static protocol explanation matches the diagnostic fields and both exception stacks; needs a controlled race test and production fix.

prioritized_plan: First fix terminal finalization / inactivity timer reinstallation race, keeping an expiry watch for genuine outstanding cleanup and proving ordering with a barrier test.

Shorten EndpointRoundRobin shared monitor: use directory address order and candidates computed outside monitor; serialize only exact cursor selection/update while preserving changing eligibility and address ring semantics. Compare planner parallelism separately; do not tie it automatically to all 256 CPUs without measurements.
Re-test carrier parallelism as an independent control; scanning is not the cause of the 121ms cursor-contention run.

Reduce per-request snapshot/projection allocation, keeping exact generation pins, version revalidation and capacity revalidation. Protobuf parsing includes both Master and mock Engine paths; do not remove required network decoding.
conclusion: The final unprofiled candidate ABBA cases pass existing assertions and the user client-P99<50ms goal. Earlier profiled candidate 3000-QPS 121ms failure and functional failures remain real evidence: cannot claim stable acceptance or attribute the historical 47/55ms solely to new drain refactor. Baseline also has unprofiled 58ms at 3000 QPS. No production edits in this rerun.
